Author: Kagekazu
Name: RelicTracker
Punchline: Track relic progress and materials across every job.
Description: Track relic weapon, tool, and armor progress across every job. Requires MogVault for current-character relic detection and material counts across bags, retainers, dresser, and armoire (replicas included). Optional FFXIV Collect sync covers relics you no longer have.
Changelog:
- MogVault is now required to track the relics and materials you own. RelicTracker explains how to install, enable, or update it if needed.
- Relic steps and armour pieces now update from your inventory. Previous completion marks still count. FFXIV Collect remains optional for relics you sold or desynthed.
- Clearer material totals, progress sources, empty results, and helper actions throughout the tracker.
